name: alon-mods

plugins.name: done-ping
plugins.description: Notifies you when Claude finishes a long task, stops on an error, or needs your answer

plugins.name: comboed-theme
plugins.description: Comboed's colors for the Claude app, switched with /comboed-theme

plugins.name: build-pane
plugins.description: A pane with your apps' GitHub Actions builds, and a notification when a new APK is ready

plugins.name: zip-guard
plugins.description: Stops a commit or push in combo-checker when combo-android/ edits are not in combo-android.zip

plugins.name: edition-guard
plugins.description: Keeps combo-checker's prank code in the full edition and the safe edition's stand-ins in step

plugins.name: smooth-stream
plugins.description: Shows Claude's reply a paragraph at a time so the screen stops jumping while you read

plugins.name: quick
plugins.description: Easy messages run on Haiku, hard ones on your usual model; quick: and full: force one; Explore subagents on Haiku

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: /whoami shows this session's ID; /second-opinion ID asks that session for the 3 biggest risks in Claude's last answer, and the review comes back here

plugins.name: prompt-booster
plugins.description: Rewrites every message you type into a clearer prompt, shows the rewrite as a small note, and answers the clearer version

plugins.name: butler
plugins.description: Turns Claude into a calm, witty AI butler with a suit-HUD look; name him yourself with /butler name

plugins.name: my-mods
plugins.description: Tells Claude which of your mods are installed and what their commands are

description: Claude Code mods for building alonhasfri's apps
